source: Morpheme Matrices, Marn Frank, ATLAS/Hamline University (expanded March 2018), Word Key, p.33-36
extraction_notes: morphemes[] gives the word-sum split (prefix, root, suffix-1, suffix-2) using canonical morpheme spellings; ordinary English spelling changes on concatenation (silent-e drop, consonant doubling e.g. fer->ferred, y/i changes) are not re-inserted, matching the 'imported -> im+port+ed' convention.
'root' names the matrix's printed root/form label (e.g. 'form', 'ceit, ceive, cept', 'gram, graph'); 'matrix' gives the matrix id it was assembled in.
Segmentation failures requiring a manual override or left unresolved: 0 (see matrices.json extraction_notes for the specific irregular words).

'contention' and 'contentions' are listed in the source's Word Key under both Matrix 15 (tend, tent, tens) and Matrix 17 (tain, ten, tin); both entries are kept here (root: 'tend, tent, tens' and root: 'tain, ten, tin' respectively) since the source itself assembles the word from two different roots rather than picking one.
